name: Vansen AugMount Installation Technician Full Rig
description: Charcoal heavy-canvas work jacket with aug-channel seams at both shoulders and forearms, worn over insulated gray work trousers with reinforced knee patches and cable-management loops at the hip. A magnification visor with dual articulating lenses flips down from a padded head harness, and an integrated ear-cup blocks high-decibel servo noise. Heavy-duty insulated gloves with conductive fingertip pads allow precision torque and live-current testing. Steel-capped composite boots with anti-static soles ground against discharge, and a double-wrap tool roll at the waist holds drivers, calibration keys, and a nerve-signal tester.
functionality: Conductive fingertip gloves allow live-current testing during aug installation without removing hand protection; anti-static boot soles prevent discharge near sensitive neural interfaces.
what_it_says: This person bolts the future onto other people's bodies for a living, and they're precise enough to do it without killing anyone.
story_hooks: The nerve-signal tester in the tool roll has a hidden secondary mode that can read — and transmit — a freshly installed aug's calibration data.
One of the calibration keys on the tool roll opens a neural lock that hasn't been manufactured in seven years.

physical_description.visual_profile: Industrial technician silhouette with tactical functionality—broad-shouldered from reinforced canvas jacket, tapered at waist by integrated tool roll, grounded stance from heavy boots. Asymmetrical equipment distribution creates a utilitarian, purpose-built aesthetic. Visor harness adds a distinctive tech-forward crown element.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through torso for movement and equipment layering, tapered at wrists and ankles for seal integrity. Trousers sit at natural waist with generous thigh room for crouching. Gloves and boots are precision-fitted for dexterity and safety compliance.
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy charcoal canvas (jacket), treated cotton-synthetic blend (trousers), reinforced neoprene-leather hybrid (gloves), ballistic composite with steel cap (boots)
physical_description.texture: Jacket surface is rough, slightly weathered from workshop use; seams are visibly reinforced with triple-stitch and cable channels. Trousers have subtle ribbed texture in high-wear areas. Gloves are smooth yet grippy with conductive silver webbing visible at fingertips. Boots show scuff marks and anti-static coating sheen.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray and gunmetal throughout; accent colors include conductive silver on fingertips and visor frame, matte black rubber at boot soles, minimal reflective piping at cuffs for low-light visibility
physical_description.closures: Jacket: heavy-duty brass YKK zippers with grip tabs; Trousers: reinforced button fly with friction-fit side cargo pockets; Gloves: elastic wrist cinches; Boots: traditional lacing with reinforced eyelets; Tool roll: magnetic snap-closure sections
distinctive_features: Shoulder and forearm aug-channel seams designed for easy access during neural-link installation
Integrated magnification visor with dual articulating lenses on padded head harness—flips down for precision work
Ear-cup attachment blocks servo noise (80+ dB dampening)
Conductive fingertip pads on gloves for live-current testing and precision torque work
Cable-management loops at hip for hose routing and tool tethering
Reinforced knee patches (treated ballistic weave) on trousers
Anti-static sole grounding contact on composite boots
Double-wrap tool roll at waist holds drivers, calibration keys, and nerve-signal tester
Triple-stitch reinforcement at all stress points
Subtle maker's mark 'VANSEN TECHNICAL' woven into jacket collar
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 professional—high-functionality specialist gear suggesting mid-tier corpo employment or skilled independent contractor. Quality construction and integrated tech indicate stable income, not luxury.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearer is a neural-augmentation technician—corpo biotech sector or high-end clinic environment. Outfit signals expertise, precision, and safety compliance. Suggests someone trusted with invasive augmentation procedures. Persona: methodical, detail-oriented, comfortable with dangerous current and microsurgery.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and well-maintained. Canvas shows subtle creasing from repeated wear; tool roll edges are softened from use. Gloves show burnished patches from frequent handling. Boots have scuff marks but soles are regularly cleaned for anti-static effectiveness. Overall: professional wear, not pristine but meticulously functional.
